convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BrainTrend2 and AbsolutelyNoLagLwma custom indicators which require external .mqh or .ex5 files; also uses MoneyManagementLib for complex MM logic

other_exits: Opposite BrainTrend2 signal closes existing position before reversal entry

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMRec: negative Lots value=fixed lots, positive=fraction of deposit at RiskPercent; uses MoneyManagementLib for margin-aware recursive sizing

custom_logic_notes: MMRec suffix means Money Management with Recursive lot calculation - if calculated lot exceeds margin, it recursively reduces until affordable. BrainTrend2 is a custom trend indicator (non-repainting variant); AbsolutelyNoLagLwma is a zero-lag linear weighted moving average. Both are accessed via iCustom and require their respective .ex5 compiled files. Signal uses previous bar values [1] for confirmation to avoid repainting. Opposite signal first closes existing position, then opens new one.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of BrainTrend2 and AbsolutelyNoLagLwma custom indicators in Python or import from equivalent libraries. The MMRec logic with recursive margin-checking lot reduction must be ported. Digit adjustment (5-digit broker SL/TP multiplication by 10) must be handled carefully. The BrainTrend2 buffer indices (0=buy signal line, 1=sell signal line) and AbsolutelyNoLagLwma buffer indices must be mapped to their computed equivalents. Signal logic reads bar [1] (previous completed bar) not [0] to avoid repainting - replicate this in Python.
